findings.problem: The plan drifts from its named roadmap candidate. `theme-weave#theme-unit` says themes are not built and that this candidate must deliver the theme unit itself (including descriptions, anchors, marks, and a library run). This plan instead assumes 1,913 existing themes across 175 books and only changes one existing flag; it explicitly excludes model runs. The roadmap and plan therefore give incompatible accounts of both current state and the work this candidate covers.
findings.suggestion: Reconcile the roadmap before approval: either update the candidate/current-state record to show theme-unit is complete and identify this as a follow-on candidate, or expand/retarget the plan so it actually delivers the named candidate.

findings.location: Assumptions and constraints, item 8; Increment C, step 4
findings.problem: The required owner-review sample is not reproducible: it says it uses a fixed seed but does not give the seed, ordering/population rules, or tie/shortfall handling. A later implementation cannot demonstrate that it selected the stated 20 old-only and 20 new-flagged themes rather than a different favorable sample.
findings.suggestion: Specify the literal seed, the sorted sampling population and selection algorithm, and behavior if either stratum has fewer than 20 eligible themes; test or record those details with the external report hash.

summary: Changes are needed to reconcile the plan with its named roadmap candidate and make the required comparison sample auditable.
